استوزرا (form X)
# اِسْتَوْزَرَا (istawzarā) /is.taw.za.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
# اُسْتُوزِرَا (ustūzirā) /us.tuː.zi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
# اِسْتَوْزِرَا (istawzirā) /is.taw.zi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
